verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents connected-account balances that can be retrieved via the API, payout management, and configurable automatic payout schedules, so seller funds can sit in a balance and be paid out on a cadence. A community comment describes letting money sit before payout, but it only raises a compliance question and does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit manual or trigger-based release tied to delivery events, documentation of hold-duration limits, dispute-window holding mechanics, and an escrow-style description of the model.
